about: The minigun class of gun (docs/guns-and-practice.md §6, C2, 2026-10-18): the Citadel's corner guns and the gatling gun. rotaryfire, the gun firing flat out, a seamless loop; rotaryspinup and rotaryspindown, the barrels' motor before and after; roundground, roundmetal, roundchitin, one round's impact on the ground, on a building or rock, on a bug. Takes are made into a scratch folder and kept in art/models/guns/sounds/; the picks are levelled into unreal/Resources/Sounds/guns/<stem>_<n>.wav (Tools/AudioGen/guns_pick.py). Mechanical weapon sounds, no voices, no music; checked offline, never played aloud.
